page.overview:
What is Igglybuff?

Igglybuff is a small, round, pink Pokémon. It has short limbs and a swirl on its forehead. Unlike its evolutions, its large eyes are red and have pupils. It also lacks ears and has a rounded tuft of fur on its head.

Its body is very soft and bouncy and wafts a soothing fragrance that calms its foes. It also seems to never stop rolling or bouncing.

Igglybuff likes to sing and will keep singing until it hurts its throat, as its vocal cords are underdeveloped.

Igglybuff evolves into Jigglypuff if leveled up with high friendship and then evolves into Wigglytuff if it touches a Moon Stone.
